description: Triage a support ticket by how badly the customer is blocked and their tier. Hand-written examples to exercise the triage graph; not a benchmark.

state.ticket: Full outage confirmed on your own status page for the last hour; we are dead in the water.
Could you add a dark mode? Not urgent, just a preference.
Every customer of ours is locked out and your login service is returning errors globally.
All scheduled jobs for our account have been stuck in 'queued' since midnight.
Nobody on our team can log in since this morning; password reset emails never arrive.
Database appears to be corrupted: records are missing for all accounts, not just ours, per your community forum.
Single sign-on works for most users, but three people have to log in twice.
Tooltips on the dashboard sometimes flicker when I move the mouse quickly.
The export we need for tomorrow's audit fails every time with 'internal error'.
The logo on the login page is a little blurry on my monitor.
Two of our five integrations show stale data; the others are fine.
Total service outage during our biggest sales event of the year; nothing loads for anyone.
Would be nice if exports remembered my last column order.
The dashboard loads, but charts render slowly and sometimes need a refresh.
Customer data from another company is appearing in our account. This is a security incident.
The font in the settings page looks slightly different from the rest of the app.
There is a typo on the billing page: 'recieve' instead of 'receive'.
Checkout returns a server error for every customer; we cannot take orders.
Report generation takes about three minutes now; it used to take thirty seconds.
Uploads over 50 MB fail intermittently; retrying usually succeeds.
Payments are being declined for all cards since the last deploy; we are losing sales.
Notifications are delayed by ten to fifteen minutes since yesterday.
The platform is down worldwide; our monitoring shows 100% error rates across all regions for the last forty minutes.
Our API key was revoked without notice and all our integrations are down.
Your status page says all systems operational, but the entire platform is unreachable for us and every other customer we have asked.
Our production webhook endpoint stopped receiving events entirely two hours ago.
We cannot publish anything; every save fails with a permissions error we did not change.
Your DNS is not resolving for the whole product; the site is unreachable from every network we tried.
CSV export works but drops the last column on files over 10,000 rows.
The weekly digest email arrived an hour later than usual this week.
Search results are missing items created in the last hour, though they show up eventually.
The changelog link in the footer points to last month's release notes.
The admin console shows a blank page for every user in our organization.
The mobile app crashes occasionally when I rotate the screen, but relaunching works.
Data sync to our warehouse has failed completely; downstream reports are empty.
API responses are slower than usual, around two seconds instead of two hundred milliseconds.
Mass data deletion in progress: files are disappearing from every workspace in our organization and others report the same.
Complete outage: the API, the web app and the mobile app all return 503 for everyone.
Our team would like a keyboard shortcut for the search box.
Minor: the date picker shows Sunday first, we prefer Monday.
